goal.en: Handle travel, describe the weather, and talk about what you do with your free time.
goal.ar: أن تتعامل مع السفر، وتصف الطقس، وتتحدث عمّا تفعله في وقت فراغك.

a2read.title: A message from a friend
a2read.text:
Hi Omar,
We got back from Türkiye last night. The journey was long — nine hours by bus from the airport — but the trip itself was wonderful.
We booked the hotel two months in advance, which saved us a lot. It rained on the first two days, so we stayed in and played cards. After that it was sunny every day and we went swimming before breakfast.
One small disaster: my brother left one piece of luggage at the station and we spent a whole morning getting it back. He does yoga now to stay calm, but it did not help.
Are you free on Friday? I have photos.
Lina

head: Word
Means
rows: register at the airport or hotel

text.en: “Travel” is not a countable noun. “I had a nice travel” is wrong — say “a nice trip” or “a nice journey”.
text.ar: كلمة travel ليست اسماً معدوداً، فجملة I had a nice travel خطأ. قل a nice trip أو a nice journey.

text.en: Luggage and baggage never take a plural -s. Count the pieces: two pieces of luggage, three bags.
text.ar: كلمتا luggage وbaggage لا تُجمعان بإضافة s، بل نعدّ القطع: two pieces of luggage.

items.en: We booked the flight two months ago.

text.en: Weather uses an empty “it”: it is raining, it was cold. English needs a subject even when there is nobody doing anything.
text.ar: الطقس يأخذ الضمير الفارغ it: it is raining. فالإنجليزية تحتاج فاعلاً حتى حين لا يوجد فاعل حقيقي.

text.en: “The weather is raining” is wrong — rain is already the verb. Say “it's raining”.
text.ar: جملة The weather is raining خطأ لأن rain فعل بذاته. الصواب it's raining.

text.en: Notice the word family: rain → rainy → rains. Learning one word gives you three, and this pattern repeats across the whole topic.
text.ar: لاحظ عائلة الكلمة: rain ثم rainy ثم rains. تعلُّم كلمة يمنحك ثلاثاً، وهذا النمط يتكرر في الموضوع كله.

text.en: Play for games with rules and teams, go + -ing for activities you go out to do, do for the rest.
text.ar: نستخدم play للألعاب ذات القواعد والفرق، وgo مع -ing للأنشطة التي تخرج لممارستها، وdo لما عدا ذلك.

text.en: “Listen music” is missing “to”. English hears things AT something: listen to music, look at a picture.
text.ar: جملة listen music ينقصها to. فالإنجليزية تستخدم حرف جر بعد هذه الأفعال: listen to music وlook at a picture.

items.en: He plays the guitar quite well.
items.ar: يعزف الغيتار بمهارة لا بأس بها.

options: We had a lovely travel to Aswan.
We had a lovely trip to Aswan.
The journey to Aswan was long.
We travelled to Aswan by train.

explanation.en: “Travel” works as a verb, not as a countable noun. The noun is trip or journey.
explanation.ar: travel فعل لا اسم معدود، والاسم المناسب هو trip أو journey.

questions.sentence: We ___ the hotel three weeks in advance.

explanation.en: You book a hotel, a flight or a table. Order is for things you buy.
explanation.ar: نحجز book فندقاً أو رحلة أو طاولة، أما order فللأشياء التي تشتريها.

questions.sentence: I only have one piece of ___ with me.

explanation.en: Luggage is uncountable, so the piece is what gets counted.
explanation.ar: luggage غير معدودة، فالمعدود هو القطعة piece.

prompt.en: Match the airport step to what happens.
prompt.ar: طابق خطوة المطار بما يحدث فيها.

pairs: You show your ticket and leave your bags.
The plane arrives on the ground.

explanation.en: These four verbs cover a whole flight, in order.
explanation.ar: هذه الأفعال الأربعة تغطي الرحلة كاملة بالترتيب.

options: It is a rainy day today.

explanation.en: Rain is already a verb, so the weather cannot “do” it. Weather can only be described: the weather is bad.
explanation.ar: rain فعل بذاته فلا يصح أن يقوم به الطقس. يمكن وصف الطقس فقط: the weather is bad.

prompt.en: Which word describes air moving strongly?
prompt.ar: أي كلمة تصف هبوب الهواء بقوة؟

explanation.en: Wind is moving air; windy is the adjective.
explanation.ar: wind هو الهواء المتحرك، وwindy صفته.

prompt.en: Give the adjective from the noun “sun”.

explanation.en: Most weather nouns add -y: sun → sunny, cloud → cloudy, fog → foggy.
explanation.ar: معظم أسماء الطقس تضيف y لتصير صفات: sun تصير sunny وcloud تصير cloudy.
الألعاب الجماعية ذات القواعد تأخذ play.

questions.sentence: She ___ yoga three times a week.

explanation.en: Yoga has no opponent and you do not go out for it, so it takes “do”.
explanation.ar: اليوغا بلا خصم ولا تخرج لممارستها، فتأخذ do.

questions.sentence: We usually ___ swimming at the weekend.

explanation.en: Activities you leave the house for take go + -ing.
explanation.ar: الأنشطة التي تخرج من البيت لأجلها تأخذ go مع -ing.

options: I listen to music every evening.
I look at old photos sometimes.

explanation.en: Listen needs “to”; watch and see do not. The preposition is part of the verb, not optional.
explanation.ar: الفعل listen يحتاج to، أما watch وsee فلا. وحرف الجر جزء من الفعل لا زيادة اختيارية.

questions.answer: I go running before work every morning

explanation.en: go + -ing, then the time expressions from smaller to larger.
explanation.ar: go مع -ing ثم عبارات الزمن من الأصغر إلى الأكبر.

prompt.en: A sign says “Departures”. What happens here?
prompt.ar: لافتة كُتب عليها Departures. ماذا يحدث هنا؟

explanation.en: Depart = leave. Its opposite on the other sign is Arrivals.
explanation.ar: depart تعني «يغادر»، ونقيضها في اللافتة الأخرى Arrivals أي الوصول.

prompt.en: “It's freezing out there.” What is the speaker saying?

explanation.en: Freezing is the everyday exaggeration for very cold, used well above 0°C.
explanation.ar: freezing مبالغة يومية تعني «برد شديد»، وتُستعمل حتى فوق الصفر بكثير.

prompt.en: How long was the bus journey from the airport?
prompt.ar: كم استغرقت رحلة الحافلة من المطار؟

explanation.en: “Nine hours by bus from the airport” — the other numbers belong to other facts.
explanation.ar: النص يقول تسع ساعات بالحافلة من المطار، وبقية الأرقام تخص وقائع أخرى.

prompt.en: Why did they stay in at the start?
prompt.ar: لماذا بقوا في الداخل في البداية؟

explanation.en: “It rained on the first two days, so we stayed in.”
explanation.ar: يقول النص إنها أمطرت أول يومين فبقوا في الداخل.

prompt.en: What went wrong on the trip?

options: A bag was left behind at the station.
They lost their passports at the airport.

explanation.en: “My brother left one piece of luggage at the station.”
explanation.ar: يقول النص إن أخاها ترك قطعة أمتعة في المحطة.

prompt.en: Which activity does the brother do?

explanation.en: He “does yoga now to stay calm”. Swimming is what the writer and others did.
explanation.ar: يمارس اليوغا ليهدأ، أما السباحة فقد مارسها الكاتب وغيره.
